incidents-bot: PAGER P1: billing.metering.token_drift detected in eu-west-1 (emitter-7). Symptoms: token-count divergence vs shadow ledger + delayed emits. Customer overage flags possible. Runbook: <https://runbooks.redwood/incident-metering>
Maya (on-call): picking this up. i see a ~48% delta in token counts for emitter-7 over the last 10m. any idea if customers are being billed yet?
Diego (billing): early telemetry: delayed batches + duplicate replays into the aggregator writeback. might be creating phantom tokens. checking reconciler now.
Oncall-SRE: kafka consumer group billing-agg-consumer showing lag ~35k on billing-usage topic around 14:02 UTC. consumer restarts loop observed. suspect commit/rebalance issue.
Harold (eng): there was a small emitter change deployed at 13:55 to emitter-7. can we pause emitter retries and put it in maintenance while we investigate?
Maya (on-call): doing that now. /ops disable-retries emitter-7 => OK. emitter-7 marked maintenance.
Diego (billing): running quick reconcile sample to estimate magnitude:
```
python tools/reconcile.py --region eu-west-1 --window 10m --sample 100
```
Result: shadow ledger > canonical by ~1.2M tokens. looks like duplicate writes, not missing writes.
Lina (support): support dashboard shows 12 customers with overage flags (UI). none have invoices issued yet. recommend we pause the billing pulse for eu-west-1 until we confirm.
Maya (on-call): pausing billing pulse for eu-west-1. /ops pause-billing-pulse eu-west-1 => CONFIRMED. notifying billing team.
Harold (eng): digging into aggregator logs. observed repeated "Commit failed, rebalancing triggered" messages followed by duplicated processing of same message for certain partitions. pushing a hotfix to make commit idempotent and ignore duplicate acks.
Diego (billing): mitigation plan: run dedupe backfill keyed by dedupe_key (request-id). estimate ~20m to converge. starting dedupe job now.
incidents-bot: Draft customer comms prepared: <https://comm-templates/redwood/metering-drift>. Lina please send once we have initial reconciliation status.
Lina (support): ok i'll send the status notice to affected customers: "We detected erroneous usage flags; we're investigating and will correct any billing errors. No invoices will be charged during this investigation." CC SRE + Billing. :white_check_mark:
Maya (on-call): update: kafka lag reduced to ~3k, retries disabled on emitter-7, dedupe job running (9% complete). monitoring.
Diego (billing): i'll own post-mitigation verification. once dedupe finishes i'll compare shadow vs canonical; target threshold 0.5% difference to clear. ETA 30m.
Harold (eng): hotfix deployed to aggregator; consumer restart loop stopped. logs show steady consumption and no duplicate ack traces after patch.
Maya (on-call): handing incident to Billing for verification and invoice hold. do not run invoice emits until Diego confirms counts reconciled. archiving incident logs under incident-7155550000.
incidents-bot: Status update: acknowledged by Maya; assigned to Diego (billing) for reconciliation; severity downgraded to P2 at 15:10 UTC. Will auto-remind in 30m.
Diego (billing): noted. will post final reconciliation summary and clear the incident if within threshold. tagging: @Lina, @Harold, @Maya."
